derivation: genitive (i.e. possessive) of G846 (αὐτός), used as an adverb of location;
def: properly, belonging to the same spot, i.e. in this (or that) place

occurrences.text: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.
And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.
And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
